The '''Driss''' flowers were grown in hydroponic gardens of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They produced a pod that was sold in the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] marketplace. [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] once served [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his companions driss pods.
